attempts.note: GOV.UK search API — does it expose an MHRA device register dataset?

summary: MHRA publishes device guidance and alerts as GOV.UK content pages. There is no public machine-readable register of UK-registered medical devices (the UK MDR register is not published as open data). Recorded as MANUAL_ONLY.
official_identifier: MHRA device registration (not publicly listed per device)
unlock_route: MHRA publishes device alerts and guidance on GOV.UK; company-level device registration data is not open. Access would require an FOI request to MHRA.
